policy: Do not generate until user reviews this written plan.
Do not collapse scenes into composite panoramas or invent extra page order.
Render each full folio independently; six-up is a contact sheet only.
Keep score, winner, record, seed, injury status and numerical forecast spaces empty unless independently verified and approved.
Preserve character reference and existing physical geography; no generic animal or Vader substitution.
No claim of real Inklings, Peter Jackson, Tim Veal or professional production team participation.
